entities.name: Query viral cell-cycle link protein
observations: 169 aa protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt O91253 from Faba bean necrotic yellows virus isolate Syrian SV292-88.
Predicted molecular weight is 19,683.5 Da and theoretical pI is 5.17.
Sequence is mildly hydrophilic (GRAVY -0.331), predicted net charge at pH 7 is -8.08, and has no reported Pfam domain hit.
Function: interacts with host retinoblastoma-related proteins (RBR), disrupting cell-cycle arrest and promoting E2F-regulated transcription to stimulate viral DNA replication.
Reported subunit interactions include host SKP1 and RBR through an LXCXE motif.

entities.name: O91253
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Faba bean necrotic yellows virus; 100% identity and 100% coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated as cell cycle link protein that interacts with host RBR proteins and SKP1.

entities.name: Q9WIJ4
observations: Reviewed Faba bean necrotic yellows virus cell cycle link protein; 92.9% identity and 100% query coverage to the sequence.
Annotated to interact with host RBR proteins through an LXCXE domain and with SKP1.

entities.name: Q9Z0D2
observations: Reviewed Milk vetch dwarf virus cell cycle link protein; 70.8% identity and approximately 99.4% coverage to the sequence.
Annotated to disrupt host RBR-mediated cell-cycle arrest and promote viral DNA replication.
